svg.title: BLE 7 - Appoint a delegate with a helper code

g.text: BLE 7 - Appoint a delegate with a helper code
hc = 4 random digits, valid 120 s or until used,
show hc large on the leader's screen
reads the code aloud / shows the screen (out of band)
songlist sheet → "Hulpleider worden", types hc [guiDesign D-73]
connect; write Control 0009 = 0x01 ‖ seal_ek{tok, cid, op 9, hc, gid} [9.8, 8.4]
open with ek; token known? hc equals the valid code?
add sid to dlg, consume hc, seq + 1, ts ↑, sign [9.4]
beacon seq; burst: new state record [7.4]
state frames → verified: own sid is in dlg [FR-LEAD-45]
banner "De leider heeft je hulpleider gemaakt";
Data: HEADER enc 2, DATA (sealed to xk), END → request list with names
drawer lists the delegate by display name, with "Intrekken" [guiDesign D-73]
After 3 wrong tries, or 120 s, the code is dead:
every further op 9 gets 0x8E until the leader
shows a new code. One try per 2 s per connection.
"Nu zingen" on a song in the Leiden tab [guiDesign D-46]
connect; Control {tok, cid, op 1 push song, ref} sealed [9.8]
apply as if done on the leader's screen; seq + 1; sign [FR-LEAD-43]
"De leider is niet bereikbaar, probeer het straks opnieuw";
remove sid from dlg, seq + 1, sign [10.12]
state → own sid no longer in dlg
(any later Control op 1-8) → 0x89 not a delegate [8.3]
A delegate that leaves (op 10) is removed from dlg by the leave itself.
The role survives a temporary loss of contact: dlg is in the signed state [FR-LEAD-46].
